system.description: You have rejected the caste into which you were Embraced, choosing instead to define your own existence and follow the path of another. While many Assamites make this choice without lasting repercussions, you have made enough waves to earn a certain notoriety — perhaps you made a public spectacle of your disinterest in your heritage, or asked a mentor in another caste to take you on as a surrogate childe. Whatever the cause, you have shown your lineage a great deal of disrespect: your sire refuses to acknowledge your existence, and the rest of your birth caste treats you with scorn. You suffer a two-Trait penalty on all Social challenges involving your Embrace caste.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
